description: This file defines the PdfShading class, which represents a shading dictionary used in PDF processing within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for setting up shading from a brush, and defines related keys for PDF shading dictionaries.

classes.name: PdfShading
classes.description: Represents a shading dictionary for PDF graphics, supporting axial and other shading types, with setup from brushes.

classes.name: PdfShading.Keys
classes.description: Contains key definitions for PDF shading dictionary entries, such as ShadingType, ColorSpace, Coords, Function, etc.

methods.name: SetupFromBrush
methods.description: Initializes the shading dictionary based on a linear gradient brush and a renderer, setting coordinates, color space, and function parameters.
